info.description: A code that admits its bearer into one community. Issued and revoked by that community's officers through the Content API; the routes in this api folder are hand-written and scoped, so no unscoped CRUD route exists.

code.description: The redeemable string, stored exactly as it is shown. The unique index is the last line of defence against a generator collision.

community.description: The community this code admits into. Set from the issuing officer's own membership, never from the request.

maxUses.description: How many times the code may be redeemed. Null means unlimited; one makes it single-use — a separate flag would only be a second thing to keep consistent with this one.

usedCount.description: Successful redemptions so far. The single counter redemption contends on.

expiresAt.description: The moment the code stops working. Null means it never expires.

revokedAt.description: Set when an officer revokes the code. Kept rather than deleting the row, so the redemptions already attributed to it stay readable.

issuedBy.description: The officer who created the code. Named `issuedBy` and not `createdBy`: Strapi reserves `created_by` for its own admin-author relation and refuses to load a content type that redefines it.

redemptions.description: Every successful use of this code, so an officer can see who a code let in without a second query.
